Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年10月24日10時31分53秒，於瓦努阿圖群島發生7.2級地震，震源深度約為10公里，震中約位於南緯13.80度，東經165.70度，距離澳門東南偏東約6947公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 24-10-2026 pelas 10:31:53 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 7.2, profundidade 10 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 6947 km a leste sudeste de Macau, (13,80S, 165,70E), Ilhas Vanuatu.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 7.2 , focal depth of 10 km, has occurred at 10:31:53 on 24 October 2026 (local time) in Vanuatu Islands. The epicentre is located near 13.80S, 165.70E, about 6947 kilometres east southeast of Macao.
